analytics.conditions: single crystal structure determination at -170 deg C, wavelength 1.54178 Angstrom
analytics.raw_text: Single crystal structure of form C: monoclinic, space group P2(1)/n. The table at lines 246-260, repeated at 266-280, gives thirteen parameters - crystal class, space group, the three unit cell lengths a, b and c in Angstrom, the three unit cell angles with beta 95.91(1) deg and the other two 90 deg, the cell volume, Z, the calculated density in Mg/m cubed, the two R factors and the wavelength. The volume is printed in nm cubed; see notes.

notes: Crystalline form C of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form C. The section is a single crystal structure table for form C and names no other substance; the space group symbol P2(1)/n, the cell axes and angles, the volume, Z, the density, the R factors and the wavelength are measurements, not compounds. is_section_product is false because this section only characterises the form and no step of it produces anything. DOCUMENT DEFECT RECORDED, NOT REPAIRED: the cell volume is printed as 1811.3(4) nm^3 at line 256, where cubic Angstrom is meant; the form A table at line 134 gives its volume in Angstrom cubed. Cubic nanometres and cubic Angstrom differ by a factor of 10^3, so the printed unit overstates the volume a thousandfold. Only the unit is wrong: the printed value is the one that closes with the printed cell edges and angle, and with the printed density at Z of 4, on the Angstrom reading. The printed unit is transcribed as it stands. A downstream density or packing check should be expected to disagree with it and must not be made to agree by editing this.
